# P1.21 — Protocols 2–4: Academic, Op-ed, Memo

Spec: `docs/tickets/49_P1.21__protocols-2-4.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.21.md`
**Stage A only** — code + deterministic tests at $0. H4 venue verification is undecided, so every
new venue/outlet row ships explicitly stale with a rendered `as_of` date (never a fabricated
`verified_at`) → `D-P1.21-1`; Stage B (prod protocol seeding + one bounded Memo run, ≤$15) is
operator-gated → `D-P1.21-2`. The merge is **operator-held**.

Stacks on `stevevitali/p1-20-settings-account` (P1.20, PR #74).

## Summary

The remaining three §6.7 protocol rows ship as **versioned `Protocol` configuration over the
shared phase manifests** — never skill forks (REQ-GENRE-1): **Academic** (journal-article /
thesis-chapter / grant-proposal; 8 dims as-is; `accept`/`minor`/`major`/`reject`/`reject premise`;
abstract+keywords required; ICMJE disclosure; no fabricated references; machine never supplies
results/data/first-person method claims), **Op-ed** (national / regional-trade; +`timeliness`;
the seeded outlet table — NYT 400–1,200, WaPo ≤750, WSJ 600–1,200, LAT ~750, USA Today 650–900,
Globe ≤700; `run`/`pass`; links-only apparatus; exclusivity + sourced-news-peg norms;
`near-final` stage), and **Memo** (six-pager / report / whitepaper; `originality`→
`decision_readiness` swap + `scope_discipline`; discourse off; `ship`/`rewrite`/`needs data`;
six-page norm; executive summary required; machine never supplies the recommendation or numbers).

**Memo confidentiality is enforced at the proxy/URL-policy layer, not by prompt discipline**
(§16.4): `user_sources[]` is a memo-only run input (`422 user_sources_memo_only` elsewhere);
source URL hosts freeze into `inputs.urlPolicy.userSourceDomains` + `fetchUserDataForbidden`;
provisioning maps both into the proxy allowlist **and** the hook URL policy — a fetch to a
user-source domain is denied pre-forward (403 + `user_source_fetch` pause signal); provider tools
get `blocked_domains`; fetch logs redact query content under the marker; a proxy n-gram guard
stops internal figures leaving inside a search query; source text mounts read-only at
`user_sources/NN-<slug>.md` and the prompt carries only a name→path index — never the bytes.
Verification against them emits `verified_against_user_source` (REQ-WF-8), and the run sheet
states the rule.

Venue honesty (REQ-GENRE-3): `verified_at`-bearing rows verify, stale rows render their `as_of`
date (`venueRowStale`/`venueRowAsOf`), `venue_table_verified_at` stays NULL while any row is
unverified. Safe-field editing stays exactly `venue`/`length_norms`/`phase_defaults`/`stage` —
the strict settings schema 422s anything outside it (REQ-GENRE-2). A settings-page protocol change
arms `protocol_changed_at`, which freezes `inputs.scopeBlocking` on the next Review and renders
"Protocol changed since vN was reviewed." — cleared by the consuming review.

AI-use statements (REQ-GENRE-5 Academic half): `packages/ai-use` gains a protocol-keyed template
registry — `icmje` (Academic), `op-ed`, `memo` — generated from run facts, append-only, never a
gate; Essay keeps `general`.

## What changed

- **Protocols** (`packages/protocols/src/protocols.ts`): the three `Protocol` literals +
  `PROTOCOL_SEEDS` (Essay, Academic, Op-ed, Memo in table order), `CapRule`/`VenueRow`/
  `VenueBarKind` types, per-protocol `phase_defaults`/`calibration_language`/`length_norms`/
  `integrity_norms`/`workflow_availability`/`user_editable`, `venueRowStale`/`venueRowAsOf`/
  `venueTableVerifiedAt`, `protocolSeedRow` + `seedProtocols` (idempotent upsert), `protocolSchema`,
  `protocolCard`, `defaultProtocolId`, `detectApparatus`. NEW `src/eval-fixtures.ts` —
  `GOLDEN_EVAL_FIXTURES` + `evalMatrix` (§13.5: every fixture under every protocol).
- **Contracts**: `BaseRubricDimension` + `ProtocolRubricDimension` (`timeliness`,
  `decision_readiness`, `scope_discipline`) → `RUBRIC_DIMENSIONS_ALL` + the extended schema;
  findings/views/sidecars accept the protocol-extended dimensions; `verified_against_user_source`
  claim verdict.
- **AI-use** (`packages/ai-use/src/templates.ts`): the per-protocol disclosure templates +
  registry; `index.ts` side-effect import.
- **API** (`apps/api/src/run-routes.ts`, `settings-routes.ts`, `sheet-context.ts`,
  `editor-routes.ts`): `normalizeUserSources` + memo-only refusal + frozen URL policy; venue-cap
  on the editor DTO; `memoConfidentiality` + the four `PROTOCOL_CARDS` on the sheet context.
- **Orchestrator**: NEW `user-sources.ts` (read-only mounts + name→path index) + runspec
  `inputs.user_sources` plumbing; allowlist/provision/resolver carry `userSourceDomains` +
  `fetchUserDataForbidden`.
- **Hooks + egress-proxy**: `user_source` deny at the hook URL policy AND pre-forward at the
  proxy (403 + `user_source_fetch` pause signal); `blocked_domains` to provider tools; query
  redaction + the n-gram guard.
- **DB**: `code-seed.ts` → `seedProtocols` (all four rows — no migration needed; the generic
  `(id, version, body)` table already carries them).
- **Web/UI**: the memo sheet's `user_sources` field + confidentiality line; the protocol-change
  scope card; protocol cards in the picker.
- **Fixtures**: `fixtures/_evals/golden-op-ed.md` + `golden-memo.md` (authored drafts); README
  updated.
